answer: Each new agent identity must lock a bond of 200 quartz tokens into a smart contract at the network's wharf registry, and the cost scales quadratically: the nth identity requires 200·n² tokens, so 100 sybils cost 2,000,000 tokens. Bonds earn nothing while hollow—agents attesting falsely lose 50% per strike, while honest agents redeem their full lockup after 30 days.
